Distribution. This species probably only occurs in the Otongachi Reserve in northern Ecuador, in the province of Pichincha (Fig. 3). We believe the ‘ additional material’ cited from Zamora-Chinchipe to be mislabeled, since that locality is over 400 km to the south, and located on the Amazonian side of the Andean crest, an unlikely distribution for a flightless beetle species. The male genitalia is identical between the two alleged localities.
